title: One public spectral excess depends on within-folio windows and the line-interior shuffle
statement: The two original public scripts reproduce #515 exactly, including the detected 44.52-character pulse. Four fixed physical folio blocks show no nominal p at or below .05 for the broad band, nearest bin, or center-band maximum in either continuous window size under the two endpoint-preserving nulls. Restricting 512-character windows to each folio gives one local paired excess, the f53–f85 block, where line-interior shuffling gives broad-band p values .02 in ZL and .05 in Takahashi, and nearest-bin .02 and .04. The broad-band ranks are .04 and .07 under folio-interior shuffling, including when scored glyph stock is exactly fixed. There is no positive criterion that is replicated across these tested nulls and layouts.
check: Reproduce the predeclared four physical blocks, verify the scored-prefix invariants and isolate what changes on f53–f85 when within-line inventories are fixed. Any proposed confirmatory comparison should keep the matched physical-folio geometry and exact scored prefix fixed across editions, specify the frequency and null in advance, and account for looking at multiple blocks and window modes.

findings: All registered training, evaluation, pulse and geometry figures match exactly.
The pulse avoided altering line-edge positions after a global glyph shuffle. It therefore keeps the endpoints of the randomized background, rather than restoring the original manuscript glyphs.

The exact original folio-interior null preserves the complete folio’s stock. It exchanges characters with the omitted tail of a truncated scored prefix. Independent seed checks verified the original endpoint and full-stock invariants in both views.

fixed_block_design.scope: Public practice only. Keep the exact strict paired loci and raw spaceless EVA representation from #515. Keep its already published period of 44. The 0.90–1.10 center band and shoulder factors 0.65–0.80 and 1.25–1.50 are fixed.
fixed_block_design.blocks: Rank distinct numbered physical folios in canonical ZL first-observed order, and assign rank i to quartile floor(4*i/N). Analyze the four quartiles independently in each practice partition, keeping page panels of a folio together. Evaluation is primary. Training quartiles are descriptive because these pages set the common period. The ZL/IT results are alternative readings of the same loci, not independent cohorts.

layout.continuous_1024: administrative quartile stream with 1,024-position nonoverlapping Hann windows
layout.within_folio_512: 512-position windows taken only within one physical folio; omit each folio's residual tail

fixed_block_design.spectrum: Compare wide band mean, the nearest center Fourier bin selected before observations (lower bin on a tie), and maximum over the entire fixed center band. Divide each by the mean of the two shoulder means. For nearest-bin sensitivity also report fixed center bins closest to periods 0.95, 1.00 and 1.05 times 44, ranked against their own permutations. Use the simultaneous maximum of the center bins for an arbitrary narrow spike anywhere in the band.
fixed_block_design.null: Use 99 shuffles from each endpoint-preserving folio-interior and line-interior permutation. Within a quartile and edition, feed identical permuted glyph streams into all window modes. Use seed 692615 plus 1000 for the line null. Preserve comparison boundaries and count ties against a positive upper-tail excess. Report supports, unavailable quartile geometry, and descriptive p-values. Give combined evidence only when the same prespecified broad or maximum statistic is positive in both editions of a fixed public evaluation block; otherwise no positive criterion is proposed. Do not recenter based on a measured peak.
fixed_block_design.calibration: Check vectorized spectral power against the published direct Fourier code on the same exact observed stream to numerical tolerance. Confirm the original injected periodic glyph in the exact replay of #515, and separate each new null's scope from that reconstruction.
fixed_block_design.scored_prefix_sensitivity: Before observing results, add a within-folio 512 null that shuffles only the retained prefix interior slots of each folio. This avoids changing the scored glyph stock by exchanging with a truncated folio tail. It preserves original line endpoints even when a 512-window boundary falls inside a line. Use 99 draws and seed 695615.

evaluation_layout.scope: Physical numbering is shared across editions. Some labels have multiple panels. Twenty-six of the 29 evaluation folio numbers also occur on separate training sides or panels. The public partitions do not represent 29 independent held-out physical leaves.

reproduction.usage: Extract the two exact scripts from the original experiment to one directory, and save the new block_sensitivity.py beside them. Run OPENBLAS_NUM_THREADS=1 PYTHONPATH=. python3 /path/to/block_sensitivity.py from the pinned public repository root. The same new test reproduced byte for byte twice.
